text.p: Blue-chip Pakistan Telecommunications Company Ltd (PTCL) fell 0.75 rupees, or 2.37 percent, to 30.90 on Wednesday after its Global Depositary Receipts (GDR) dropped internationally, dealers said.
A turnover of 5.397 million PTCL shares was recorded at the Karachi bourse by midsession.
"The stock is under pressure as its GDR rates fell abroad," dealer Ather Raouf said. "Foreign investors are disappointed because of the continued delay in the privatisation of PTCL."
The government had originally hoped to privatise PTCL by end-1995, but has yet to set a deadline for investors to bid for a 26 percent stake and management control of the phone utility.
PTCL, usually the volume leader at the Karachi stock exchange, is also under pressure because of a generally bearish mood prompted by economic and political jitters, dealers said.
